content_of_post_to_comment: Someone told me my article was good. Then said it was a shame I needed AI to help. No one says that about a human editor. The thinking was mine. AI helped me find the words. Somewhere we decided that kind of help is the shameful kind, and I'm not sure we ever asked why.
comment: Maybe the deeper issue is that we confuse the value of a finished work with the purity of the process behind it. We accept tools in every craft; the harder question is where authorship actually begins and ends.
